Cryptographic Algorithm Implementation Requirements and Usage Guidance for ESP and AH

sources.readBy: transform type 1-5 tables (all IDs and names in this rule book)

policyNote: RFC 8247 says its levels are implementation requirements and that the algorithms a deployment uses are dictated by its own security policy. This rule book turns those levels into an audit policy. The mapping, the severities and the thresholds below are project policy and can be tuned in this file.

classes.FORBIDDEN: MUST NOT, or deprecated by RFC 8247 / RFC 9395, or no confidentiality (NULL). Fails the rule.
classes.DISCOURAGED: SHOULD NOT, or weak by project policy. Fails the rule.
classes.LEGACY: Still permitted but being phased out (for example MUST- or short tags). Fails with LOW severity.
classes.ACCEPTABLE: MUST / SHOULD / MAY without security concerns. Passes.

rules.title: IKEv1 must not be used
rules.notEvaluatedWhen: The capture contains no IKE SA.
rules.recommendation: Migrate the tunnel to IKEv2. Do not import IKEv1 crypto settings unchanged (RFC 9395).

rules.title: IKE SA encryption algorithm
rules.failWhen: Selected algorithm is FORBIDDEN, DISCOURAGED or LEGACY in the encryption table (severity from the table), or its key length is below thresholds.minSymmetricKeyBits.
rules.notEvaluatedWhen: IKE_SA_INIT is not in the capture (selected is null); the ID is not in the table; a variable-key-length cipher has no key length.
rules.recommendation: Use ENCR_AES_GCM_16, ENCR_CHACHA20_POLY1305, or ENCR_AES_CBC with a 256-bit key plus HMAC-SHA2-256.

rules.title: IKE SA integrity algorithm
rules.failWhen: Cipher is not AEAD and integrity is null or NONE (CRITICAL), or the integrity algorithm is FORBIDDEN or LEGACY in the integrity table (severity from the table).
rules.notEvaluatedWhen: IKE_SA_INIT is not in the capture; the encryption or integrity ID is not in the tables.
rules.reference: RFC 8247 section 2.1 (non-AEAD ciphers MUST be used with an integrity algorithm) and 2.3
rules.recommendation: Use an AEAD cipher (no separate integrity), or HMAC-SHA2-256/512 with a non-AEAD cipher.
rules.passNote: An AEAD cipher with no integrity transform is correct and passes.

rules.title: IKE SA pseudorandom function
rules.failWhen: Selected PRF is FORBIDDEN or LEGACY in the PRF table (severity from the table).
rules.notEvaluatedWhen: IKE_SA_INIT is not in the capture; the ID is not in the table.

rules.title: IKE SA Diffie-Hellman group
rules.failWhen: Selected group is FORBIDDEN, DISCOURAGED or LEGACY in the DH table (severity from the table).
rules.notEvaluatedWhen: IKE_SA_INIT is not in the capture; the ID is not in the table.
rules.reference: RFC 8247 section 2.4 and section 5 (the DH group is the most important parameter: breaking it later exposes all ESP traffic)
rules.recommendation: Use group 14 (2048-bit MODP) at minimum. Prefer group 19, 20, 31 or 15 and larger.

rules.title: Weak algorithms offered in IKE_SA_INIT
rules.failWhen: Any offered ENCR / INTEG / PRF / D-H transform is FORBIDDEN or DISCOURAGED (even if a strong one was selected). Evidence lists the offered IDs.
rules.notEvaluatedWhen: The initiator's request is not in the capture (offered is empty).
rules.reference: RFC 8247 (transcript collision attacks against weak hashes are cited as a reason to remove MD5); RFC 9395 section 6
rules.recommendation: Remove the listed algorithms from the proposal so a weak suite can never be negotiated.
rules.passNote: Only the initiator's offer is visible. Whether the responder would accept the weak options is not.

rules.title: Child SA (ESP) encryption algorithm
rules.failWhen: Selected algorithm is FORBIDDEN, DISCOURAGED or LEGACY in the encryption table. ENCR_NULL and ENCR_NULL_AUTH_AES_GMAC are CRITICAL (traffic is not encrypted).
rules.recommendation: Use ENCR_AES_GCM_16 or ENCR_CHACHA20_POLY1305 for ESP.

rules.title: Child SA (ESP) integrity
rules.failWhen: Cipher is not AEAD and integrity is null or NONE (CRITICAL), or the integrity algorithm is FORBIDDEN or LEGACY in the integrity table.
rules.reference: RFC 8221 section 4 (encryption without authentication MUST NOT be used)
rules.recommendation: Use an AEAD cipher, or pair the cipher with AUTH_HMAC_SHA2_256_128 or AUTH_HMAC_SHA2_512_256.

rules.title: Perfect forward secrecy on child SA rekey
rules.failWhen: pfs.determinable is true and pfs.enabled is false.
rules.notEvaluatedWhen: pfs.determinable is false (no decrypted CREATE_CHILD_SA seen).
rules.reference: Project policy (common hardening guidance; not an RFC requirement)
rules.recommendation: Add a DH group to the child (ESP) proposal so every rekey performs a fresh key exchange.

rules.title: Child SA PFS Diffie-Hellman group
rules.failWhen: Selected group is FORBIDDEN, DISCOURAGED or LEGACY in the DH table.
rules.notEvaluatedWhen: No decrypted CREATE_CHILD_SA response has a DH group (also covers PFS being off: CHILD-PFS-001 reports that).
rules.recommendation: Use group 14 at minimum; prefer group 19, 20, 31 or 15 and larger.

rules.title: Child SA rekey interval
rules.failWhen: intervalSeconds is greater than thresholds.maxChildRekeySeconds. This is a definite FAIL even when lowerBoundOnly is true, because the real interval is at least that long.
rules.notEvaluatedWhen: No rekey interval was observed; or lowerBoundOnly is true and the interval is within the threshold (the real value may exceed it).
rules.reference: Project policy (IKEv2 does not carry lifetimes on the wire, so only observed rekey intervals are used)
rules.recommendation: Shorten the child SA lifetime, or add a volume (bytes/packets) limit, so keys are replaced regularly.
rules.passNote: PASS needs a complete interval (lowerBoundOnly false) within the threshold.
